style: The Pacific Ocean near Guam, January 1960.

titles: The Steel Ball That Fell Seven Miles
Two Men Reached the Deepest Point on Earth

meta.description:
In 1960 two men sank to the bottom of the Challenger Deep.

How the Trieste got there, and what nearly went wrong.

Subscribe for more true stories.
